groups.title: Performance
groups.blurb: Rendering, frame pacing, memory and tick rate. The mods that stop costing you frames.

groups.title: Visuals
groups.blurb: Connected textures, shaders and lighting. Looks good without giving back the frames.

groups.title: Quality of life
groups.blurb: Maps, schematics, HUDs and inventory tools. The things you would have installed anyway.

groups.title: Tweaks
groups.blurb: Small fixes to the game itself, plus crash tooling when something does break.
